body:
Path-scoped rules for the accessibility tree, keyboard/focus handling, painted colours and the stand.
Source: `.andromeda/a11y-plan.md` — tier 0, target SC 2.1.1 (keyboard) · 1.4.3 (contrast) · 2.4.3 (focus order). The reach is published in `docs/capabilities.md` under `## Accessibility reach` (tier 0, those three criteria and no other, the `a11y` leg's files, what an assistive technology reads unmeasured, the named limits — the focus fixup firing no `blur`, a single select's `size` unread, `aria-activedescendant` unread); its pin `.github/scripts/test_capability_statement.py` reads none of these claims, so a change that moves the reach is made in that document by hand.

- A Tab / Shift+Tab key-press focus check exists on the stand (`stand_snapshot_state`, through the harness's `press` / `press_with`; `stand_accessibility_ids` pins the lean tasks' `focus_next_node` sequence); a range-input key and click check runs in both layout modes (`range_input_interaction`, a disabled range taking neither keys nor a click; on the stand `stand_act_range` moves the Timer slider through the driver by click and key, and an arrow step after two Tabs leaves it focused with role `Slider`, its name and the forward focus sequence unchanged); since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness `stand_keyboard` drives Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the CRUD list's keys headlessly on the four lean tasks through the same `press` / `press_with`, reading the focused node back per step in both layout modes, and pins the flight booker's `select#flight-type` moving its choice by its arrows (`the_flight_type_select_moves_its_choice_by_its_arrows`) — each task's stated sequence is the shared table `tab_order` (CRUD six stops, `crud-list` third: it takes `tabindex="0"` and an `onkeydown`, ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Home / End moving the selection, its rows not focusable), and through the driver `stand_act_keys` presses `enter` and `space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment`; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the walk is also asserted in two enabled states, each reached by keyboard alone (`enable_by_keyboard`), against the shared table `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` beside `tab_order` in the shared module — the flight booker after the return flight is chosen on `select#flight-type` by ArrowDown, five stops (its boot `tab_order` four, `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-book`); CRUD after a row is selected, eight — every `controls(task)` id lying in `tab_order` ∪ `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, and Enter and Space read as the click of `crud-update` and `crud-delete` (4 rows), so a control enabled after boot needs its place in `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, while the load page and Cells hold Tab-order, keyboard and contrast rows (`stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast`, `stand_load_page`, `stand_cells_served`) — `stand_keyboard` walks the shared tables `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and `CELLS_TAB_ORDER`, beside `tab_order` and `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, forward and back in both layout modes, the load page's button taking Enter and Space, Cells' arrows and Enter opening the moved-to cell's editor and its value committing by keyboard, Tab leaving an open editor and a click on another cell each committing it, and the arrows clamping at the grid's ends and bringing a cell into view — so SC 2.1.1 and 1.4.3 are asserted on the load page's `load-fetch` Button and on Cells' `cells-grid`; a select key and typeahead check runs in both layout modes — `select_interaction` (18 tests: a 14-row keys table and a 7-row typeahead table, one `input` and one `change` per change and none for no change, `has_changes` asserted per row, the typed text kept for one second of the document's clock, a disabled select taking no key and no click, an app writing `selected` re-seeding the choice) and, through the driver, `stand_act_select` (10 tests: Tab `fx-before` → `fx-pick` → `fx-named` → `fx-after` → `fx-before`, the disabled `fx-off` skipped, equal before and after the choices, an option chosen by a click then a key) — both in the `a11y` leg, both three rounds in the `stand-repeat` leg, `stand_act_select` by its `stand_` prefix and `select_interaction` by the leg's named `--test` list; the select list's keyboard and focus coverage is headless — `select_popup` (25 tests), `stand_act_popup` (12) and `stand_keyboard`'s list walks (`the_flight_type_walk_holds_with_its_list_open_and_after_each_close`, `a_click_opens_the_list_focus_stays_on_the_select_and_the_walk_goes_on_from_it`) assert SC 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 on it in both layout modes, and the windowed list is read and not run. Cells: `cells-grid`, named `Cells` by `aria_label` with no role, is one Tab stop; the arrows move `current`, clamped, and bring the cell into view; Enter opens the editor on `current`, focused, and the editor's Enter commits and returns focus to the grid; Tab leaving an open editor commits it; `.cells-grid:focus .cell.current` draws a 2px outline in the stand accent; role and cell semantics stay out, owned by residual `res-wvatzhpe` (re-carried at 0.3.0, target: next).

- The a11y CI leg (`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh a11y`) runs its files since 2026-10-24-a11y-re-read — `accessibility_hidden`, `accessibility_roles`, `focusability_updates`, `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast`, `stand_accessibility_ids` (the six since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions, the stand's keyboard, contrast and accessibility-id assertions), then `accessibility_states`, `accessibility_label`, `accessibility_description`, `accessibility_merged_states`, `accessibility_active_descendant_unread`, `inert_subtree`, `select_interaction` and `stand_act_select` (the founder's «Плюс проверки дерева (Рекомендую)») — the six widened on the founder's F4 (2026-10-14) with no new job, no required status check and no repository setting; since 2026-10-14-quality-gates `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast` and `stand_accessibility_ids`, as `stand_*` files, also run three times in the `stand-repeat` leg (job `Stand checks repeated`) under the zero-failure budget (test-plan §10), the a11y leg and job then unchanged; `accessibility_states` (6 tests: the three state attributes, one stated table per attribute with its row count asserted, the fourth reading `aria-checked` on a checkable role alone and four unchecked natives reading neither attribute, the fifth `aria-pressed` on a checkable role reading nothing), `accessibility_names` and, since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts, upstream's `accessibility_label` (13) and `accessibility_description` (3), which assert the name and description reads with `verify_that!`, and `accessibility_merged_states` (3: `aria-expanded`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-level`), `inert_subtree` (6) and `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` (1), which assert the builder off the built tree in both layout modes, ride the workspace test leg, per package and, since 2026-10-24-a11y-re-read, this one — `accessibility_names` alone excepted, left out of this leg with `focus_redraw` and `focus_within`; `accessibility_states`, `inert_subtree` and `accessibility_active_descendant_unread`, outside the `stand_` prefix, also run three rounds in the `stand-repeat` leg by its fixed `--test` list, each keeping its name, and in this leg too — as `select_interaction` (by that list) and `stand_act_select` (by its `stand_` prefix) are, so each runs in both the `a11y` and `stand-repeat` legs, as `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast` and `stand_accessibility_ids` do. `select_popup`, `select_popup_painted` and `stand_act_popup` run in the workspace `test` leg and three `stand-repeat` rounds, the first two by its named `--test` list and `stand_act_popup` by its `stand_*` glob; none is among this leg's files, though `stand_keyboard`, one of them, carries the list's walk here.

**Tier:** 0
**WCAG target:** SC 2.1.1 Keyboard · SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) · SC 2.4.3 Focus Order — the reach (tier, criteria, the `a11y` leg's files with no required status check, what an assistive technology reads unmeasured, the named limits) published in `docs/capabilities.md` under `## Accessibility reach`; its pin `.github/scripts/test_capability_statement.py` reads none of these claims, so a change to the reach is made in that document by hand

- **Keyboard harness:** a Tab and Shift+Tab key-press focus check exists on the stand, driven through the harness's `press` / `press_with` (`stand_snapshot_state.rs`); since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction a range-input key and click check runs in both layout modes (`range_input_interaction.rs`: a 7-row keys table and a 5-row clicks table, one `input` per change and none on a no-change Home, the input focused after every click, a disabled range taking neither keys nor a click), and on the stand `stand_act_range.rs` moves the Timer slider through the driver by click and key, an arrow step after two Tabs leaving it focused with role `Slider`, its name and the forward focus sequence unchanged; since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness `stand_keyboard.rs` drives Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the CRUD list's keys headlessly on the four lean tasks through the same `press` / `press_with`, reading the focused node back per step, in both layout modes, and pins the flight booker's `select#flight-type` (named `Flight type` by `aria-label`, its second Tab stop) moving its choice by its arrows (`the_flight_type_select_moves_its_choice_by_its_arrows`), and walks the load page's `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and Cells' `CELLS_TAB_ORDER` forward and back in both layout modes, the load page's button taking Enter and Space, Cells' arrows and Enter opening the moved-to cell's editor and its value committing by keyboard; a select key and typeahead check runs in both layout modes — `select_interaction` (18 tests: a 14-row keys table and a 7-row typeahead table, one `input` and one `change` per change and none for no change, the typed text kept for one second of the document's clock, a disabled select taking no key and no click) and, through the driver, `stand_act_select` (10 tests: Tab `fx-before` → `fx-pick` → `fx-named` → `fx-after` → `fx-before`, the disabled `fx-off` skipped, an option chosen by a click then a key) — both in the `a11y` leg, both three rounds in the `stand-repeat` leg, `stand_act_select` by its `stand_` prefix and `select_interaction` by the leg's named `--test` list; the select list's keyboard and focus coverage is headless — `select_popup` (25 tests), `stand_act_popup` (12) and `stand_keyboard`'s list walks (`the_flight_type_walk_holds_with_its_list_open_and_after_each_close`, `a_click_opens_the_list_focus_stays_on_the_select_and_the_walk_goes_on_from_it`) assert SC 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 on it in both layout modes, `stand_keyboard` in the `a11y` leg and the other two outside it, in the workspace `test` leg and three `stand-repeat` rounds, and the windowed list is read and not run.

4. SC assertions on every stand control, gating merges through the a11y CI leg (the `a11y` job runs the accessibility integration tests — `a11y-ci-gate-wire` discharged) → discharged: since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the `a11y` leg runs the stand's keyboard, contrast and accessibility-id assertions (six files then, since 2026-10-24-a11y-re-read the five tree-reading checks and the three tier-0 witnesses `inert_subtree`, `select_interaction` and `stand_act_select` joining), and since 2026-10-14-quality-gates those three also run three times in the `stand-repeat` leg under the zero-failure budget

- `tests/blitz-tests` — one test target per file (upstream's single-binary `tests/all.rs` is declared at `test = false` and never built, pinned by `BlitzTestsTargetsTest` in the `ci-scripts` leg) — integration tests across accessibility (hidden content, roles, names and, in `accessibility_states` (6), the builder's three state attributes — every value of each grammar, row counts asserted — and
